tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bzhi thog mgon khang chen mo gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bla ma'i lung bstan mngon du gyur pa'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i nying khu sor bzhag la rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta'i lo mgon khang chen mo de nyid kyi mdo tshoms chen ngo mtshar can la nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bur bgyis skabs kyi dkar chag 'jam mgon gong ma dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī mahā ka la ye/ ngo mtshar rgyal kun thugs bskyed rgya mtsho las/ /legs 'ong gdul bya'i mkha' la gzugs sku'i nyi/ /rmad byung mdzad pa'i 'od brgyas bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /ster mkhas 'jam mgon kun dga' bsod nams rgyal/ /dam pa gang de'i thugs bskyed rmad byung gis/ /bskrun pa'i ma hā kā la'i pho brang che/ /de dang stabs gcig rig 'dzin dge 'dun gyi/ /'du khang chen mo gsar spel mdzad 'phrin la/ /zhabs 'degs tshul du kun blo mched bcas kyis/ /nyams gso bgyis pa'i dkar chag mdo tsam zhig /'bri la'ang thog mar sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen/ /'jam mgon ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /mdzad pa'i dkar chag rnying pa nyid smos na/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'dir gdan sa thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu gyur pa dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /bzhi thog bla brang chen mo'i nub phyogs 'dir/ /gur gyi mgon po la sogs sa skya pa'i/ /bka' srung rnams kyis rjes bzung rnal 'byor pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /sngon nas med pa gsar du bskrun pa yi/ /mgon khang chen mo srid gsum rnam rgyal zhes/ /mtshan du gsol 'di sngon tshe bka' drin can/ /yab rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i mtshan/ /de nyid gsung las nged kyis bsam pa la/ /ji ltar yod pa'i rigs 'dzin lha khang dang / /de yi 'og gi mgon khang gsar bzhengs sogs/

/nged kyis re ba'i lhag ma 'di dag kun/ /khyed kyis lag len byed dgos 'gyur ro zhes/ /sngags 'chang de nyid gzhan ngor sku bsnyen pa'i/ /rnam pa tsam yang ston par ma mdzad pa'i/ /sngon rol nyid nas yang yang bka' bstsal pa/ /deng dus mngon du gyur tshe yab rje der/ /dus gsum sgrib med gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan/ /nges par mnga' bas dad pa cher spel nas/ /yi dam du ma'i tshogs kyi bris thang dang / /chos skyong gur zhal dur khrod bdag po dang / /phyi nang gsang ba'i las mkhan dkar bdud dang / /phur srung bcu gnyis dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ /phyag bzhi phyag drug beng dang trag shad dang / /stag zhon zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul sogs/ /mdor na chos skyong srung ma'i rigs mang po'i/ /bris thang bla ma gong ma'i phyag nas dang / /thugs dam rten gyur ye shes mngon sum du/ /bzhugs par nges pa'i bris thang bgrang yas rnams/ /mgon khang chen mo'i logs dang ka ba yi/ /nges rnams dag la bstan par bzhugs gsol zhing / /rten gyi gtso bo yab rje de nyid kyi/ /phyag bris 'khrul med gur zhal rnam pa gnyis/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i bris thang drug phrag gcig /khyad par bstan srung so sor dngos byon 'dra'i/ /'bur sku gsar bzhengs gur mgon lha bcu gnyis/ /ru 'dren sde bzhir bcas dang zhing skyong gtso/ /bram ze'i gzugs can dkar bdud lcam dral dang / /nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis/ /dmag zor rgyal mor bcas pa'i sku rnams te/ /rten mchog rnams kyi steng du zhing chen gyi/ /bla re che dang ka ba bar snang sogs/ /kun tu khyab pa'i chos skyong 'khor bcas kyi/ /phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs gcan gzan pags pa'i tshogs/ /khrab rmog gri sogs dpa' bo'i chas mang po/ /gos dar lda ldi 'phyang 'phrul thug chen sogs/ /spyan gzigs ma tshang med pas kun khyab cing / /gzhan yang dam rdzas gtor tshogs ri ltar spungs/

/dam nyams bsgral ba'i thod pa mchod rdzas kyis/ /phyur bur bkang ba mang po tshar du dngar/ /rnga chen dung chen la sogs dam can rnams/ /mnyes par byed pa'i yo byad kyis gang ba'i/ /gnas der slebs pa tsam gyis skye bo kun/ /'jigs shing skyi bung byed pa'i mgon khang 'di/ /yab rje de nyid dgongs pa rdzogs phyir bsgrubs/ /de rjes 'phags chen dam pa'i mdzad pa yi/ /rjes su slob 'dun lcags pho rta yi lor/ /'du khang chen mo'i nyams gso zhus pa'i tshul/ /bdag cag spun la blo gtad gson gshin gyi/ /dngos rnams dge rtsa chen por spel ba'i phyir/ /rtsi tshon gser shog sogs su yongs bsgyur te/ /nyams gso gsar spel 'du byed tshul ming sogs/ /bi shwa karma zhing 'dir 'ongs 'dra yi/ /bkod pa sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dge mtshan ni/ /bad mgo'i logs la lam zab bla brgyud mtshan/ /ma hā kā la rigs byed lha mo'i sngags/ /lha yi yi ge dag par yongs bskrun zhing / /de mtshungs ka zhu gdung sogs mtha' dag la/ /ngo mtshar ri mo'i bkod pa rgya cher spel/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag slob mar bcas dang 'gro ba kun/ /tshe ring nad med bsam pa mthar phyin zhing / /'chi tshe bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi myong bar/ /chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las bcol ba ltar/ /mkha' spyod bde ldan mngon dga' la sogs pa/ /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med legs 'khrid nas/ /zhing de'i rgyal las zab mo'i chos nos te/ /rang rgyud grol nas gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sa skya pa/ /khyad par sngags 'chang yab sras bstan 'di nyid/ /srid mthar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mthu ldan shog /gzhan yang sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos kun dga' bsod nams kyi/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su yongs rdzogs nas/ /kun blo mched kyi 'di dang phyi ma'i don/ /'bad med lhun grub bsam don mthar phyin shog

/bye brag gnas 'dir mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi/ /bstan pa dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel gyur te/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'khor ba ma stongs bar du rgyas gyur cig /ces dkar chag 'jam mgon gong ma dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas zhes bya ba 'di ni rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag nges pa'i don du drug pa rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis shing / rang don kun rdzob tu yang paṇḍita dang / rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa du mar sku'i skye ba yang nas yang du bzhes shing / khyad par bdag cag gi ston pa'i bka' gsang ba bla na med pa las/ ma 'ongs dmu rgod chos la bskul phyir du/ /byams pa spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /pad 'byung sku yi sprul par mchog dbang bskur/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya 'byung / /zhes gsal bar lung bstan pa'i 'brel tshad don ldan gyi skyes bu mtshan brjod par dka' zhing / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gyi sgra tsam thos pas kyang skye rgu mtha' dag gi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa cig car du 'joms shing / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu stsol pa de nyid la/ gong gi yab rje sems dpa' chen po grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis ma 'ongs sgrib bral gzigs pa'i bka' lung mtha' yas pa zhig gnang zhing / khyad par ngos kyi bsam pa la yod pa'i rig 'dzin lha khang steng 'og gi rten bzhengs 'phro can 'di rnams khyed kyis bsgrig dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid don ldan du bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gtso gyur gyi gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer ma mchis pa rnams kyi nang rten dngul gdung rin po che rnams bzhugs pa'i pho brang rigs 'dzin lha khang du mtshan gsol ba 'di nyid na bzhugs pa'i rigs 'dzin bla ma brgyud pa'i sku 'dra rin po che rnams kyi kha bskang dgos pa rnams dang /

de dang chabs cig de'i 'og rje btsun sa skya pa'i chos srung thun mong ma yin pa gur mgon lha bcu gnyis/ ru 'dren sdabazhi/ gnyan mgon bram ze'i gzugs can/ nor skyong yab yum/ dkar bdud lcam dral/ rje nyid la bka' babs pa'i dmag zor lha mo bcas kyi 'bur sku mthong ba don ldan rnams dang / gzhan yang dam pa gong ma'i thugs dam rten bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha bcas kyi bris thang byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba til gyi gong bu ltar bzhugs pa'i mgon khang srid gsum rnam rgyal dang / de'i mdor mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag dbang 'byor ba'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gzhal yas khang tshoms chen mor mtshan gsol ba 'di nyid bcas/ mdor na yab rje grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi thugs dgongs lhag ma mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs par bsgrubs par mdzad pa ni sngags 'chang bla ma nyid kyi zhal sgo las byon pa'i dkar chag ngo mtshar gtam gyi phreng ba 'di nyid bzhin yin la/ de nas lo grangs mang du song ba dang / khyad par rang re rjes 'jug rnams 'khos kha zhan zhing rtog rtsings che bas gog nyams su song 'dug pa blos ma bzod de/ dam pa de nyid kyi rigs dbon gyi tha shal pa sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mched kyis nyams gso gsar bzhengs lta bur bgyis pa 'di ni kho bo cag spun bla tshul du song bas shi gson dkor nag char babs pa bzhin byung ba rnams log 'tshor song na gnyis 'phung du gyur dogs gtso cher gong ma'i sgrub mchod dkar me dus ja dang / de lhag gdan sa 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang phal mo che'i nyams gso 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bdag rkyen du smin pa'i ngag bkod mdzod par byas don bzhin go re len shes rab phun tshogs nas kyang mthun 'gyur bgyis te bsgrubs pa la dkar chag mtshan don tsam smos pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bsti gnas bzhi thog bla brang gi yang steng phun tshogs 'chi med rdo rje'i gur khang du sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa byang zhing /

tshogs gnyis rdzogs te bstan 'gror phan bde spel ba'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa bsod nams 'od zer dang / slad kyi bris pa dam pa nyid kyi bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba rin chen yar 'phel gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ bzhi thog mgon khang chen mo gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
